scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && cd apps/data && uv sync
scripts.ready: vp fmt && vp lint && vp run test -r && vp run build -r
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,native,data,search -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:native" "pnpm run dev:data" "pnpm run dev:search"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently -n web,native,data,search -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm --filter native run ios" "pnpm run dev:data" "pnpm run dev:search"
scripts.dev:search: cd apps/data && quickwit run 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered -E '(REST server is ready|ERROR|FATAL)'
scripts.dev:data: cd apps/data && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.check: pnpm exec vp check --fix && cd apps/data && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web exec vp test && cd apps/data && uv run pytest
scripts.test:integration: cd apps/data && uv run python tests/test_integration.py
scripts.data:clear: rm -f apps/data/ducklake.ducklake && rm -rf apps/data/local_data && rm -rf apps/data/qwdata && rm -rf apps/data/local_turfs && mkdir -p apps/data/qwdata
scripts.data:mock: cd apps/data && uv run python mock.py
